content:
The incident was caused by the systemd journal filling /var. On inventory‑db‑01 the `/var/log/journal` directory had grown to dominate the filesystem because `/etc/systemd/journald.conf` had no size limit set. With no retention policy, journald kept all logs, eventually exhausting /var and preventing the shell from writing its history. The issue was resolved by adding a size limit (or vacuuming) to the journal.
